description: This file defines a PHP class 'GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate' that extends another class to manage display fields with aggregate functions in a reporting context, specifically mapping fields like 'empLocation' to database entities with aggregation like 'MIN'.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A class for handling display fields with associated aggregate functions, capable of generating SQL select parts with aggregate syntax.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias, field, and aggregate based on the display field's alias.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Returns the aggregate function applied to the field.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregate function for the display field.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates the SQL SELECT part with the aggregate function applied to the field.
